## Request Context
- What was requested: full pre-commit /review of the B1-floor + interpreted-assessment implementation (SPEC-20260523-100224). Confirm the floor closes B1's Prime-Objective (b)/(c) gap; the escalate-only bridge cannot demote; confidentiality holds at counts/ntfy/write_event sinks; secret-scrub fails closed; no regression to the v1 safety contract (never push / pinned dropped / opt-in gate).
- Files/scope: change_package.py (R1 floor + R4 reclassify_route/RouteDecision), assessment.py (NEW R2/R8/R5/R6), distribute.md (R3/R3a/R5/R6/R7), tests/test_distribute.py (35 new incl. B1 regression), docs/adr/ADR-0017 (NEW, clears B5).
- Developer-stated motivation: a raw diff will not let the gatekeeper decide; the gate must show its work and teach; core fear is silently breaking a downstream project.
- Explicit constraints: interpretation rides on the same unreliable ancestor as B1 (ancestor/3-way merge deferred v1.1); the FLOOR not the agent is the consent guarantee; reclassification escalate-only; diff data is a sibling not on ChangeItem; content-free at all sinks; no push; isolated worktree.

VERDICT: REQUEST-CHANGES (0.84). BLOCKING (Scenario A): the escalate-only bridge is MECHANICAL at classification but PROSE at staging. reclassify_route returns a route string; it never mutates ChangeItem.classification, so an escalated value-unverified file is STILL in package.stageable and stage() would physically copy it onto the branch. The only thing preventing the silent clobber is distribute.md's instruction (escalated non-empty -> UNMEDIABLE -> stage nothing). The floor was made mechanical; its escape hatch was left behavioral — asymmetric, and B1-reborn if orchestration is ever refactored to Python. FIX: make stage() escalation-aware (escalated_paths param that skips those files) + a test that an escalated file is never written even if in package.stageable. ADVISORY: B fail-closed redact aborts whole target on hub hook churn (assert SECRET_PATTERNS in pre-flight); C counted disclaimer exhaustion at scale (N can be 150 on a stale target -> add 'M are behavioral, read those first'); D reclassify_route co-gate depends on triage_hint PROVENANCE (deterministic R2 output) which the type system doesn't enforce — a future caller passing an agent-derived hint silently disarms the injection defense. STRENGTHS: floor genuinely mechanical (value unreachable by fall-through, B1 regression reproduces+passes); interpretation EXPLAIN-only (iterates requires_interpretation, agent cannot un-flag); injection co-gate correct polarity; confidentiality structural (OverwriteDiff sibling).

VERDICT: REQUEST-CHANGES (0.88). Suite solid: B1 stale_baseline regression genuinely reproduces the bug and would fail under old value code; reclassify_route parametrize covers the co-gate matrix; content-free sink tests are proper negatives. 3 BLOCKING: F1 the B1 regression test has NO entry in memory/bugs/regression-ledger.md (the gate's regression guard checks ledger<->test linkage; the keystone is unanchored). F2 redact_secrets fail-closed branch (raises when _SECRET_PATTERNS_LOADED False) is UNTESTED — monkeypatch the flag and assert RuntimeError. F3 the _classify deleted-drift branch (target deleted file, hub re-adds -> collision-diverged) is UNTESTED — a regression there silently re-adds a deliberately-removed file (consent violation). ADVISORY: F4 add .yaml version(cosmetic)/structural(behavioral) triage tests; F5 the None-drift (tracked_paths-narrowed) value-unverified path is untested (package_env's inert g.md takes the target_hash-None branch first, not the floor); F6 tighten test_one_diff_per_flagged weak membership assertion to == behavioral.

VERDICT: approve-with-changes (0.88), 0 blocking. Core security properties hold by construction. ADVISORY F1: redact_secrets sets _SECRET_PATTERNS_LOADED=True purely on import success — if a future hook refactor makes SECRET_PATTERNS an empty list, scrubbing silently no-ops. Add post-import guard: if not SECRET_PATTERNS: _SECRET_PATTERNS_LOADED=False. ADVISORY F2: R3a is prose to an LLM; injection can't change ROUTING (escalate-only co-gate forecloses it) but could taint free-text doc fields (room_summary) — mark room_summary visibly '(agent-supplied)'. VERIFIED-SAFE: baseline_gate_green code-exec surface is documented+accepted (single-owner). Trust boundaries all closed: branch-name validation covers all 3 refs; git_cmd list-form (no shell); ntfy reply allow-list; difflib not subprocess. STRENGTHS: redact_secrets fails closed; confidentiality structural (no diff_text field on ChangeItem); reclassify_route pure+tested; B1 regression high-quality.

VERDICT: request-changes (0.86) — but its two BLOCKING findings (F1 tests still assert retired value taxonomy at lines 307/332; F2 SPEC-mandated B1 tests not written) are based on reading the MAIN-CHECKOUT tests/test_distribute.py (stale v1), NOT the worktree copy under review — its dispatch omitted the worktree path for the test file. The worktree test file HAS all 35 tests (TestMechanicalFloor/StaleBaselineRegression/ReclassifyRoute/etc.), updated assertions, and passes 67/67. F1/F2 to be DISCARDED in verification (wrong file). VALID findings: production architecture is sound — mechanical/judgment split cut correctly (acyclic classifier->sibling assessment->orchestrator; assessment imports ChangePackage under TYPE_CHECKING only; change_package never imports assessment); RouteDecision frozen sibling, no temporal coupling; OverwriteDiff off ChangeItem = structural confidentiality; ADR-0017 faithful + discharges B5 + aligns ADR-0003/0015. ADVISORY F3: scripts->.claude/hooks sys.path import is fragile (consider shared module later). F4(info): value never produced is already asserted by test_value_is_never_produced_in_v1.

Finding verification: 7 verified, 0 inconclusive, 2 DISCARDED. DISCARDED (verified:false): architecture-consultant F1 (tests assert retired value taxonomy at 307/332) and F2 (B1-floor tests not written) — both read the MAIN-CHECKOUT tests/test_distribute.py (stale v1), not the worktree copy under review (its dispatch omitted the worktree path for the test file). Worktree verification: 41 token-matches for value-unverified/reclassify_route/OverwriteDiff/triage_diff/build_assessment_doc/stale_baseline_env/Test classes; the flagged lines assert value-unverified (322/347/654/686); 58 test functions; 67/67 pass. VERIFIED-TRUE: independent Scenario A (stage() reads package.stageable which still contains escalated files; only distribute.md prose prevents staging them — real prose-vs-mechanical gap); qa F1 (no B1 row in regression-ledger.md), qa F2 (redact fail-closed untested), qa F3 (deleted-drift branch untested); security F1 (empty-SECRET_PATTERNS fail-open after successful import) + F2 (room_summary free-text injection surface). LESSON: when /review runs in a worktree, specialist dispatch MUST give worktree paths for ALL reviewed files or agents read the stale main checkout.

## Request Context
- What was requested: pre-commit /review of the B1-floor build (SPEC-20260523-100224); confirm the floor closes B1 mechanically, escalate-only can't demote, confidentiality at all sinks, secret-scrub fails closed, no v1 safety regression.
- Files/scope: change_package.py, assessment.py (NEW), distribute.md, tests/test_distribute.py (35 new), ADR-0017 (NEW).
- Developer-stated motivation: gate must show its work and teach; core fear is silently breaking a downstream project.
- Explicit constraints: floor (not agent) is the consent guarantee; reclassification escalate-only; content-free at all sinks; ancestor fix deferred v1.1; no push; isolated worktree.

## Synthesis
VERDICT: REQUEST-CHANGES. The production architecture is sound and praised by all four (mechanical/judgment split clean+acyclic, RouteDecision frozen sibling, OverwriteDiff off ChangeItem = structural confidentiality, ADR-0017 discharges B5, floor genuinely mechanical at classification, B1 regression reproduces+passes). 4 BLOCKING (verified): (1) independent Scenario A — the escalate-only guarantee is PROSE not mechanical: stage() copies package.stageable which still includes escalated value-unverified files; only distribute.md prevents it. Fix: stage() escalation-aware (escalated_paths skip) + test. (2) qa F1 — add the B1 regression-ledger entry. (3) qa F2 — test redact_secrets fail-closed. (4) qa F3 — test the deleted-drift collision-diverged branch. ADVISORY (fold cheap): security F1 empty-patterns post-import guard; qa F5 None-drift value-unverified test; qa F6 tighten weak assertion; security F2 (agent-supplied) label; independent D triage_hint provenance; independent C disclaimer-exhaustion (v1.1). DISCARDED: architecture F1/F2 (reviewed stale main-checkout test file, not the worktree). speculative:0 (all findings >=0.80). Model tiers: qa-specialist:sonnet, security-specialist:opus, architecture-consultant:opus, independent-perspective:opus.
